description: Defines the PrioritizedDispatcher class for managing job dispatching based on priority and limits, including nested classes for Job and Limits, with methods for adding, canceling, changing priority, and managing limits.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher
classes.description: A class that manages job dispatching based on priority levels and limits, ensuring controlled execution and queuing of jobs.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Job
classes.description: Interface for jobs managed by PrioritizedDispatcher, requiring implementation of Start() method.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Limits
classes.description: Structure defining limits for total jobs and reserved slots per priority.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a job with specified priority to the dispatcher, starting it immediately if limits allow.

methods.name: AddAtHead
methods.description: Adds a job at the front of the queue for its priority.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Removes a job from the queue using its handle.

methods.name: EvictOldestLowest
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest lowest-priority job.

methods.name: ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of a queued job.

methods.name: OnJobFinished
methods.description: Notifies the dispatcher that a job has finished, potentially starting new jobs.

methods.name: GetLimits
methods.description: Retrieves current limits for the dispatcher.

methods.name: SetLimits
methods.description: Updates limits and starts jobs if permitted.

methods.name: SetLimitsToZero
methods.description: Sets all limits to zero, preventing new jobs from starting.
